description.value: Paragon Pizza is a locally owned and operated fast-food pizza shop on Victoria Drive in Vancouver, serving handcrafted pizzas made with fresh ingredients across a range of veggie, chicken, and meat toppings. The shop offers a simple, welcoming dine-in space alongside pickup and delivery options. It sits on a busy commercial corridor that touring cyclists traveling the east side of Vancouver may pass through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, phone number, and general address; the postal code on the website (V5P 1Y8) differs from OSM (V5P 3Y8), and the online ordering page shows a third variant (V5P 1Y5), so address is flagged. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered via the online ordering page, and a 'Veggie' menu category confirms at minimum vegetarian options. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V5P 3Y8, website contact sections consistently show V5P 1Y8, and the online ordering page shows a third variant V5P 1Y5 — correct postcode should be verified.
No cycling amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water bottle refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags, making it impossible to determine whether this listing meets minimum directory standards without an on-site check.
